Branch: mick/ltx2-prompt-kv-once-per-loop (on main 02b983603d), commit 80375713c2

## Motivation

LTX-2 re-projects the prompt in every block of every denoising step. The 1024-token caption goes through `caption_projection` (two GEMMs, video and audio), and then each block's two prompt cross-attentions (`attn2`, `audio_attn2`) project it to K and V and RMS-normalize K. Neither the text nor the DiT weights change inside a denoising loop: the LoRA phase switch runs before the loop. On 4xB300 (CFG parallel, BCG) these are ~3.4 ms of every 55 ms stage-1 step. TensorRT-LLM caches the same projections per request.

## Modifications

- `models/dits/ltx_2.py`
  - `LTX2Attention.project_context_kv(context)` returns the normed K and the V that `forward` would project. `forward` takes `context_kv=(k, v)` and skips `to_k` / `to_v` / `k_norm`.
  - `LTX2VideoTransformer3DModel.prepare_prompt_kv(encoder_hidden_states, audio_encoder_hidden_states)` runs the caption projections and every block's prompt K/V once. It writes them into persistent per-block buffers keyed by the text shapes and returns that key. The forward takes `cached_prompt_kv=<key>`, skips the caption projections and hands each block its K/V. The buffers keep their addresses across requests, so a breakable CUDA graph captured at warmup reads the current request's K/V.
  - `caches_prompt_kv` is false when the prompt is adaLN-modulated per step (`cross_attention_adaln`, LTX-2.3), whose K/V depend on the step.
- `ltx_2/denoising.py`: on the official CFG path, `_use_cached_ltx2_prompt_kv` prepares the K/V on the loop's first step (`LTX2DenoisingContext.prompt_kv_key`) and passes the key to every step. It keeps the per-step projection under layerwise offload (weights stream per block) and cache-dit.

## Tests

- `test_ltx2_prompt_kv_cache.py`
  - A 2-block LTX-2 forward with `cached_prompt_kv` is bitwise equal to the per-step projection.
  - A second text is written into the same buffers (same data pointers), and the cached forward matches the uncached one for it.
  - `caches_prompt_kv` is false with `cross_attention_adaln`.
  - The stage prepares once per loop and leaves the kwargs untouched for an LTX-2.3 DiT, under layerwise offload and under cache-dit.
- `test_ltx2_bcg_coords.py`: its stub DiT reads the prompt itself, so the step test stubs the new hook.

## Accuracy Tests

4xB300 (2 GPUs used), LTX-2 two-stage 768x512x121, 40 steps, CFG parallel + breakable CUDA graphs. MP4s of 4 requests are byte-identical (md5) to main + #45965 / #45977 / #46047.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same setup, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`, median of 3 steady requests:

| | stage 1 (40 steps) | per step |
|---|---|---|
| base | 2.205 s | 55.1 ms |
| this PR | 2.062 s | 51.5 ms |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class TestLTX2PromptKVCache(CustomTestCase):

+            kwargs = _forward_kwargs(text_seed=1)

+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def test_new_text_is_written_into_the_same_buffers(self):

+            model = _tiny_model()
+            first = _cached(model, _forward_kwargs(text_seed=1))
+            buffers = model._prompt_kv_buffers[first["cached_prompt_kv"]]
+            pointers = [t.data_ptr() for kv in buffers for t in (*kv.video, *kv.audio)]
+            second_kwargs = _forward_kwargs(text_seed=2)

+class TestLTX2StagePromptKV(CustomTestCase):
+    def _model(self, *, caches: bool = True, offloaded: bool = False):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            caches_prompt_kv=caches,
+            layerwise_offload_managers=[object()] if offloaded else [],
+            prepare_prompt_kv=Mock(return_value=(1, 6, 64, 1, 6, 32)),
+        )
+
+    def _use(self, model, ctx, *, cache_dit: bool = False) -> dict:
+        stage = SimpleNamespace(_cache_dit_enabled=cache_dit)
+        kwargs = {
+            "encoder_hidden_states": torch.zeros(1),
+            "audio_encoder_hidden_states": torch.zeros(1),
+        }
+        return LTX2DenoisingStage._use_cached_ltx2_prompt_kv(
+            stage, ctx, SimpleNamespace(current_model=model), kwargs
+        )
+
+    def test_projects_once_per_loop(self):
+        model = self._model()
+        ctx = SimpleNamespace(prompt_kv_key=None)
+        for _ in range(3):
+            kwargs = self._use(model, ctx)
+        model.prepare_prompt_kv.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs["cached_prompt_kv"], (1, 6, 64, 1, 6, 32))
+        self.assertIsNone(kwargs["encoder_hidden_states"])
+        self.assertIsNone(kwargs["audio_encoder_hidden_states"])
+
+    def test_keeps_projecting_when_the_weights_or_text_may_move(self):
+        for model, cache_dit in (
+            (self._model(caches=False), False),
+            (self._model(offloaded=True), False),
+            (self._model(), True),

+            kwargs = self._use(
+                model, SimpleNamespace(prompt_kv_key=None), cache_dit=cache_dit
+            )
+            self.assertNotIn("cached_prompt_kv", kwargs)
